capabilities: Generate filenames from note content with AI
Review proposed names before applying them
Run renames on the selected note, text or files
Buy and track AI credits in settings
extras: Needs a Constance account; purchases go through Paddle in USD, with a free allowance plus purchased balance. Selected input is sent to an AI service, and error reports including file paths or content details go to Datadog.
problem: Note filenames often do not reflect what the note contains, and renaming them by hand one at a time is tedious.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.

summary: Renames Markdown notes with AI-generated filenames, either automatically or after reviewing the proposed names.
